title: Remote Jobs Scraper – Jobicy, Working Nomads, Arbeitnow +4
description: Remote job postings from seven public boards (Remotive, Remote OK, Jobicy, Arbeitnow, Working Nomads, Himalayas, We Work Remotely) in one normalized, newest-first schema, de-duplicated so the same job is never billed twice. Filter by keyword, company, location, salary and date. Covers Arbeitnow API.
seoTitle: Remote Work Scraper, Remote Hiring Data API, Job Alerts API
seoDescription: A recruitment data API and employment data API for remote hiring: remote jobs dataset and job postings dataset in one schema, with job monitoring API alerts and a job aggregator API on seven boards.

job.eventDescription: One unique, de-duplicated remote job posting returned to the dataset.
